The songbook

The set list on the left has all thirteen carols — click one to see its sheet music with lyrics and guitar chords. You can print any single song, or print the entire songbook and bring it with you.

Help us fix the music

We're still checking every carol against published sheet music, and some have wrong notes, lyrics under the wrong notes, or chords that clash. Each problem is listed as an issue. If you spot a mistake or want to take one on, please jump in.

Jingle Bells

James Lord Pierpont, 1857
✓ Curated — checked against a lead sheet from RiffSpot.com (Easy Guitar)
2. A day or two ago, I thought I'd take a ride,
And soon Miss Fannie Bright was seated by my side;
The horse was lean and lank, misfortune seemed his lot,
He got into a drifted bank and then we got upsot. (Chorus)
3. A day or two ago, the story I must tell,
I went out on the snow, and on my back I fell;
A gent was riding by in a one-horse open sleigh,
He laughed as there I sprawling lie, but quickly drove away. (Chorus)
4. Now the ground is white, go it while you're young,
Take the girls tonight and sing this sleighing song;
Just get a bob-tailed bay, two-forty as his speed,
Hitch him to an open sleigh and crack! you'll take the lead. (Chorus)

Jingle-Bell Rock

Words and Music by Joe Beal and Jim Boothe
Key of C. Moderate shuffle, swing (quarter note = 130).
Chords only. Each | is one bar of 4 beats; two chords in a bar get 2 beats each.

VERSE   "Jingle-bell, jingle-bell, jingle-bell rock ..."

  | C   Cmaj7 | C        | C#o7     | Dm  G7   |
  | Dm  G7    | Dm  G7   |

  Verses 1 and 3 end:   | Dm       | G7#5     |   then back to the top
  Verses 2 and 4 end:   | D7  G7   | C   C7   |   then on to the bridge

BRIDGE  "What a bright time, it's the right time ..."

  | F        | F#o7     | C        | ...

  (The chart we have stops here; the rest of the bridge is missing.)

Chord key:  o7 = diminished seventh,  #5 = sharp five,  maj7 = major seventh
